requests.prompt: Create a production sprite atlas for a French Mass Effect 1 fan RPG using pre-rendered HD 2D sprites in an orthographic 3D world. EDIT/DERIVE FROM THE FIRST ATTACHED enemy-atlas.png: use ONLY the heavily built geth destroyer, the FOURTH character from the left on the TOP ROW. Do not draw any of the other seven enemies. The second attached Prima ME1 page15 contains a small named Geth Destroyer image and text for limited primary context only: do not copy text, logos, panels, HUD or layout from that page. Preserve this game's prototype destroyer identity: broad powerful shoulders and chest, dark blue-gray metal armor with worn muted red trim plates, thick segmented mechanical limbs, large claw feet, narrow forward-curved geth head with one blue-white optic, and ribbed black tubes over its back and shoulder. Its heavy two-handed firearm is a consistent generic illustrated weapon across all poses; do not turn it into a different canonical rifle or certify an exact model. This is the existing ME1 destroyer, not a Juggernaut, Prime or later-game robot; do not add a new helmet, spikes, wings, extra limbs or glowing aura. Camera is fixed three-quarter orthographic facing image-left. Art matches the supplied prototype's realistic adult mechanical proportions, soft neutral upper-left lighting, sharply readable silhouette and metallic material details. OUTPUT exactly one landscape 1536x1024 PNG with true transparent alpha, exactly FOUR separate complete figures of this SAME destroyer in a spacious two-by-two layout. Leave minimum60 transparent pixels around every figure and broad empty central gutters, no silhouette crossing a neighboring cell. TOP LEFT: full-body combat-ready aimed heavy rifle pose, muzzle left, both feet visible. TOP RIGHT: full-body braced attack/action pose with weapon brought forward to left, weight shifting, no flame, projectile, muzzle flash, shield or baked VFX, feet visible. BOTTOM LEFT: full-body received-hit recoil, torso angled backward with one foot bracing, same armor and heavy weapon retained, no spark, smoke or blood. BOTTOM RIGHT: defeated inert destroyer lying horizontally, head at LEFT feet at RIGHT, full body and weapon visible inside quadrant with clear transparent margin, no detached pieces. Upright figures about350-380pixels high each, consistent shoulder width and limb proportions; defeated figure about600pixels long, low horizontal silhouette. No words, labels, numbers, logos, scenery, HUD, borders, mockup boxes, checkerboard, colored background, rectangular halo or extra figures. Do not invent a new attack animation or a complete cycle: just these four distinct fixed poses.
